scenario: Store a trust decision for a real project directory, read it through a directory symlink alias, update it through the alias, then read the result through the real path.

pisharp.baseline_result: Failed: trust saved at the real directory returned null through the symlink alias.

result: PiSharp now canonicalizes existing directory symlinks before trust lookups, writes and protected-resource checks; trust decisions through real and alias paths share one persisted entry.
evidence_boundary: Pi current-source direct store invocation compared with PiSharp deterministic unit coverage; not an interactive /trust terminal-flow differential.
